author: Mark Atwood
text: Marking human-needed. Throughout the 2026-05-12 do-beads session, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and the untracked OLD/ directory remained in their pre-session state — explicitly NOT staged into any commit because they predate this session and are out of scope for the spec-fix beads worked. The .beads/ files have continued to accumulate session changes (claims/closes/comments via bd commands); those auto-commit through Dolt independently. Decision still belongs to Mark: commit AGENTS/CLAUDE/OLD with appropriate context, stash, discard, or continue leaving them.
